# Radboud Repository

> > Radboud Repository is an institutional open-access digital repository for scholarly research, publications, and academic output from Radboud University and its affiliated researchers.

Radboud Repository serves as the central platform for discovering, accessing, and depositing peer-reviewed research, academic publications, and scholarly work from Radboud University faculty and research centers. The repository emphasizes open-access principles, copyright compliance, and institutional knowledge preservation across multiple disciplines including law, sciences, and humanities.

## Discovery & Search

- [Search](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/discover): Main search interface for discovering scholarly articles and research in Radboud Repository
- [Community List](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/community-list): Browse Radboud University faculty and institutional research collections by community

## Content Submission & Management

- [Upload Full text](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/page/uploadfulltext): Guide for uploading full-text publications to Radboud Repository with copyright permissions

## Legal & Compliance

- [Notice and Takedown](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/page/noticeandtakedown): Copyright complaint and content removal procedures for Radboud Repository
- [Terms of Use](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/page/termsofuse): Legal terms, copyright policies, and Dutch Copyright Act compliance for repository usage

## Featured Research Publications

- [Authentication and authorisation and the access of the user in the Data Act](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/handle/2066/330224): Academic publication analyzing user authentication and access rights under EU Data Act
- [De enquêtebevoegdheid van de rechtspersoon](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/handle/2066/330234): Academic publication on corporate inquiry procedures in Dutch company law
- [Commissaris met financieel belang](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/handle/2066/330229): Academic article on corporate governance conflicts of interest in Dutch company law
- [Noot bij: HR 11 november 2016, JOR, 2017, 2](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/handle/2066/330233): Legal annotation on Curaçao inquiry procedures and statute of limitations in company law
- [Noot bij: HR 04 november 2016, JOR, 2017, 1](https://repository.ubn.ru.nl/handle/2066/330232): Legal annotation on SNS case regarding shareholders' rights in inquiry procedures
